name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
summary: Nek'rosh's Gambit is an urgent strike mission commissioned by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor. Learning that Chieftain Nek'rosh has constructed siege engines to bombard the vulnerable port town while reinforcements remain cut off at Dun Algaz, the Alliance sends brave volunteers deep into the marshes to burn the Dragonmaw catapults before an assault can begin.

sections.title: A Looming Siege
sections.body: While Alliance adventurers were clashing with Dragonmaw raiding parties, dwarven scouts uncovered the clan's true ambition. Chieftain Nek'rosh has overseen the construction of full-scale siege catapults in the wetlands encampments. His goal is bold and catastrophic: to march his war engines to Menethil Harbor and batter down the fortress walls, wiping out the Alliance's primary shipping hub on the western coast.

sections.title: Cut Off at Dun Algaz
sections.body: Menethil Harbor's peril is magnified by the choke point at Dun Algaz. Heavy skirmishes and greenskin activity in the mountain pass effectively isolate the lowlands from Ironforge's main garrisons. Without immediate aid from Khaz Modan, Captain Stoutfist cannot spare a defensive detachment to guard the perimeter, making a preemptive sabotage of the catapults the harbor's sole chance for survival.

sections.title: Fire in the Encampment
sections.body: Armed with Dwarven Tinder, scouts must push directly into the heart of the Dragonmaw encampment. Setting the bulky timber engines ablaze robs Nek'rosh of his artillery, leaving his warriors exposed and denying them the firepower needed to crack Menethil's defenses before the warlord himself can be confronted.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh is the ruthless chieftain leading the remnants of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. He is orchestrating a direct military campaign to besiege Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is Menethil Harbor in such danger?
faq.answer: The town relies heavily on naval trade and is physically separated from Ironforge. Because the passes at Dun Algaz are congested with fighting, no reinforcements can arrive by land, leaving the town unable to withstand a concentrated siege.

faq.q: What is the goal of this mission?
faq.answer: You are tasked with taking Dwarven Tinder into the Dragonmaw encampment to ignite and destroy their siege catapults before they can be rolled out against Menethil Harbor.
Captain Stoutfist, the dwarf officer coordinating the harbor's local defense and the campaign against the Dragonmaw, hands down the orders.

faq.q: What follows the destruction of the catapults?
faq.answer: Once their siege engines are reduced to ash, the threat must be extinguished permanently by tracking down and executing Chieftain Nek'rosh himself.

faq.q: Why can't Ironforge send troops to help Menethil?
faq.answer: The road linking Loch Modan to the Wetlands runs through Dun Algaz, which is heavily contested and ambushed by hostile forces, severing reliable ground transit.

angles.text: Menethil Harbor serves as Bronzebeard dwarfdom's gateway to the western sea; losing it to Dragonmaw siege weapons would cripple Ironforge's maritime connections.
With Dun Algaz locked down in combat, the Alliance must rely on brave volunteers rather than standing armies to disrupt the Dragonmaw war machine.
Storming an entrenched enemy war camp to destroy heavy siege artillery requires aggressive frontline tactics and brutal hand-to-hand fighting.
